title: Window Tinting Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for tint shops — full-vehicle ceramic packages, per-window film, windshield strips, old-film removal, flat-glass work, and mobile call-outs. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.

faqs.q: What should I include on a window tinting invoice?
faqs.a: Your business details and license number, the client's name, and the vehicle (year, make, model — and VIN or plate if you want an airtight record). List each service on its own line: full-vehicle package or per-window film, the film brand and VLT % installed (e.g. 'ceramic 35% front doors'), old-film removal, and any mobile fee. Add your state sales tax, the total, and your cure instructions in the notes.

faqs.q: How much should I charge for window tinting?
faqs.a: Full-vehicle packages run $150–$300 for dyed film, $250–$500 for carbon, and $400–$800+ for ceramic on a sedan (SUVs and trucks add $50–$150). Individual windows bill $60–$120 each, a windshield visor strip is $50–$100, and old-film removal adds $25–$50 per window ($100–$200 per vehicle). Residential flat-glass work runs $5–$10 per square foot installed.

faqs.q: Should old film removal be a separate line item?
faqs.a: Yes — always. Removal is slow, messy work (steamer, scraper, adhesive solvent) that customers underestimate. Billing it as its own line at $25–$50 per window sets expectations before you start, and lets you quote tint-only pricing cleanly for new vehicles that need no removal.

faqs.q: Do tint laws affect the invoice?
faqs.a: They affect the paperwork. Most states regulate windshield strip height and minimum VLT for front doors, and several (California, Texas, Florida among them) actively cite illegal film. Writing the film type and VLT % on the invoice documents what you installed — useful if the customer later claims you put on an illegal shade. Never invoice for a shade you know violates the state's law.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if your state does not tax tinting services.
